description: Whether the hooks are installed as PowerUp runs now. notInstalled unless the settings file is a JSON object whose hooks.Stop array holds a group referencing the quoted command or the legacy path; outOfDate when only the legacy path is there, when any of the five events is not an array holding a group with the quoted command, when the script is missing, or when its bytes are not the body for the current port and token; installed otherwise. isInstalled looks only at Stop, legacy path included.
function: HookInstaller.installState(port:token:settingsURL:) and isInstalled(settingsURL:) — input {settings, scriptPath, scriptOnDisk, port, token}: settings as install.json; scriptOnDisk the script file's bytes (a string, {"hex": <bytes>}, {"scriptFor": {port, token}} for the body script.json pins, {"scriptForWithoutTrailingNewline": {port, token}} for that body without its last byte, or null for no file); expected {installState, isInstalled}: installState one of notInstalled, installed, outOfDate
verifiedBy: DESIGN.md v1.4, v1.10, v2.14; Tests/PowerUpTests/HookFixtureTests.swift testHookInstallStateTable writes the settings and the script to temporary files and asks HookInstaller.installState and isInstalled. Rust: rust/powerup-core/tests/hooks.rs install_state_cases runs hooks::install_state and hooks::is_installed.
capturedAgainst: Swift 5.9.2 Foundation (Xcode 15.2) on macOS 27.2, PowerUp at 2dd77aa
